{{Top}}
{{Youmay|durasteel|[[Steel (disambiguation)|another use of the term]]}}
[[File:Jango_Fett_Fathead.png|thumb|250px|Jango Fett's armor, fashioned from durasteel]]
{{Quote|When processed, ore becomes durasteel, which is used to make buildings and defenses strong.|Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
'''Durasteel''' was an incredibly strong and versatile metal alloy, that was stronger and more durable than conventional [[Steel/Legends|steel]]. It was usually produced in metallurgical plants or specialised durasteel foundries for both civilian and military use. 

== Characteristics ==
Durasteel was composed of [[Iron/Legends|iron]], [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] and various heavier elements, including [[carvanium]], [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]], [[Meleenium/Legends|meleenium]], [[Neutronium/Legends|neutronium]], and [[Zersium/Legends|zersium]]. It was also lightweight and capable of withstanding blistering heat, frigid cold, and immense physical stress,<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> even in thin sections. Because of these properties, durasteel was used in a wide variety of applications, ranging from smelting pots for less durable metals to [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] hulls and buildings.<ref name="TCSWE" /> However, it could still corrode in the same manner as lesser steel alloys, and likewise required maintenance. Durasteel containers were commonly seen throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. While weaker than most [[:Category:Lightsaber-resistant_materials|lightsaber-resistant materials]], durasteel was still resistant to lightsabers, although not outright impervious to them.

== Examples ==
[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] armor was partly made of durasteel, and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] had some parts of his body made of this material.

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armor]] was mostly made of durasteel, as was [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] before he upgraded during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] to armor made of [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']].

Both durasteel and [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]] were used for the buildings of [[Bartyn's Landing]].<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

==Durasteel grades==
Durasteel was produced in various grades of heat treatment and alloy composition for different construction purposes. Some of these were:
*[[9093-T7511]] grade
*[[9095-T8511]] grade
*[[Madog steel]]
